description:
Two defects in the realization hash/binding path, found while running the guard against a downstream adopter corpus.

1. Cross-path hash comparison fabricated drift. canonicalize_head/1 emits structurally different envelopes per resolution path (BEAM 4-tuple over all clauses vs source-fallback 5-tuple over the first def clause), so an unchanged function hashes two ways and a cold tree reports plausible-looking realization drift.

2. api_boundary dedupe collapsed authored bindings by MFA. collect_bindings/2 deduped on MFA alone, first-seen wins: an implication-inferred subject entry shadowed authored requirement bindings, and authored entries from different requirements sharing one MFA collapsed to a single entry with requirement_id: nil.

Advances: specled.api_boundary, specled.binding, specled.realized_by

Lands as one release PR (0.14.0). Child 1 is a prerequisite for child 2 (shared realization_hashes.json baseline).
